newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lihir lifts 1997 gold output forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lihir lifts 1997 gold output forecast.

text.p: Papua New Guinea gold miner Lihir Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it had revised up its gold production forecast for calendar 1997 to 175,000 ounces from 120,000 ounces.
Lihir said good progress in construction of processing facilities had prompted the forecast revision.

It said the commissioning of the facilities for processing oxide ores would begin in May 1997, earlier than forecast, and that processing of sulphide ores should begin by October 1997, rather than the earlier December 1997 forecast.
By the end of July, engineering was 92 percent complete and contruction was 32 percent complete, Lihir said.
